headline: Virgin Media O2 to Cut Thousands of Jobs, Sky News Reports
summary: British telecom firm Virgin Media O2 is planning to cut up to 4,000 jobs. Most of the reductions are expected to affect non-customer-facing roles.
why: Virgin Media O2 is one of the largest telecommunications and broadband providers in the United Kingdom, formed by a joint venture between Liberty Global and Telefónica.

impacts.name: Virgin Media O2
impacts.why: Large-scale job cuts can reduce operating expenses but may indicate restructuring challenges.
